final_prompt: Use case: infographic-story. Asset type: wide cover infographic illustration for a Chinese tech blog article. Primary request: Create a wide cinematic infographic-story cover illustration that summarizes ASP.NET Core cooperative request timeouts. The reader should quickly understand that reaching a deadline sends a cancellation signal, and downstream work stops only when that signal travels through the call chain. Summary angle: a server timer crosses a three-second deadline and launches one visible cancellation pulse through an endpoint toward a database and an external HTTP dependency, ending in a compact 504 result. Narrative flow: 3-beat process. In a 2.35:1 frame, keep one dominant focal subject and three supporting narrative beats. Information blocks: mechanism, a central server timer reaches the 3-second mark with approved label '3 秒'; step, one bright pulse travels through a simplified endpoint path to a database cylinder and an HTTP node with approved label '取消传递'; takeaway, the path ends at a restrained red status chip with approved label '504'. Main metaphor: a timer-triggered cancellation pulse moving through a call chain. Subject: a pixel-art server timer with a clear three-second marker, actively sending the pulse downstream. Composition/framing: diagonal left-to-right progression, central timer as the only strong focal point, two simple downstream dependency forms on the right, generous negative space, aspect ratio 2.35:1. Style/medium: combine editorial technical illustration with retro pixel-art inspired illustration, blocky forms, limited palette, old game composition cues, readable wide layout. Stylized, polished, editorial, and clearly readable as an infographic-story cover. Do not imitate a specific brand, studio, or living artist. Color palette: deep navy, warm amber, warning red, cool white. Visible text policy: allow only the three approved short labels '3 秒', '取消传递', and '504'. No poster title, no long sentences, no English slogans, no fake UI labels, no fake chart axes, no fake architecture node names. Constraints: no watermark, no prompt residue, no screenshots, no dashboards, no fake diagrams, no fake charts, no fake terminal output, no fabricated metrics, no unrelated icon collage, no decorative clutter. Avoid real product UI, terminal output, code rain, neon city, generic robots, floating chips, and complex architecture diagrams.
